rounds.text: Supreme Power Equipment Ltd is currently demonstrating superior operational efficiency, evidenced by an ROE of 19.4% and an ROCE of 22.0%, both of which significantly outperform their respective sector benchmarks [E9, E10, E12, E13]. The company is successfully scaling its business, maintaining a consistent 22% compounded sales growth rate while simultaneously improving its working capital cycle, with debtor days dropping from 139 to 94.1 and overall working capital requirements falling from 94.0 to 39.1 days [E14, E15, E51, E52]. The completion of major capital expenditure, indicated by a 40.8% reduction in capital work-in-progress, suggests that the company is well-positioned to capitalize on the current capital goods sector tailwind [E32, E61, E63]. Furthermore, the intrinsic value of Rs 343 per share, as calculated by the discounted cash flow model, provides a 19.5% margin of safety against the current market price [E37, E38]. Conceded: the company pays no dividends [E4, E53], and the stock is currently trading at a premium to sector benchmarks in terms of P/E, P/B, and EV/EBITDA ratios [E6, E7, E11]. Despite these valuation premiums, the institutional money flow remains positive, and the company’s ability to fully back its profits with operating cash flow confirms the quality of its earnings [E25, E28, E36].
